speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: I have them out, Master Shakespeare. I would not begin the showing until John is through the door. He is in the yard, and he is not counting anything I can see.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave them out. I can see three, and I will not start until John is in the room.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I could have the new mouthful in me before he has his foot on the boards. My ear is awake. It has been awake since I woke.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it awake and keep it shut. Not before he is in the room. Sit on thy hands if they itch for a cue.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: The weight is on the trestle, for after. The ink I mean to use is in the horn, and the horn is shut. I am not writing a letter until someone has chosen which letter.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: If the choosing takes till dinner, the afternoon will paint me with the old line still in my teeth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The choosing will not take till dinner. It will take as long as three rolls take to be honest. Thou art not painted yet. Nobody in this room is painted yet.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Here he is. I will lay them so a man can see the fault without a speech from me about the fault. The speech can be his, or yours. I have had mine on the walk up.
